title: Vampire Vape Desserts Caramelised Banana Pancake 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Caramelised Banana Pancake by Vampire Vape Desserts Koncept range delivers the rich taste of golden banana slices seared in syrupy sugar, layered over a warm, buttery pancake base. This dessert-inspired e-liquid captures the familiar comfort of a classic pancake stack, pairing smooth banana flavour with notes of caramelised glaze and subtle pastry notes. Blended at 70% VG to 30% PG, this high-VG shortfill is made for sub-ohm vaping, producing dense vapour and deep flavour. Supplied as 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid in a 120ml bottle, there’s space to add two 10ml nicotine shots to customise the strength to your liking. Made in the UK to the highest standards, Caramelised Banana Pancake is part of the Vampire Vape Desserts collection — a range of sweet, comforting blends inspired by classic dessert flavours. Also available in Freebase 10mls and Concentrates for DIY mixing.
